'''''Pyracantha koidzumii''''' commonly known as '''Formosa firethorn'''<ref name=hsu>{{cite web|url=http://www.hsu.edu/interior2.aspx?id=8412|title=''Pyracantha koidzumii''|publisher=[[Henderson State University]]|access-date=April 9, 2013|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130626175211/http://www.hsu.edu/interior2.aspx?id=8412|archive-date=June 26, 2013}}</ref> or '''Taiwan firethorn''', is a species of [[plant]] in the family [[Rosaceae]]. It is threatened by [[habitat destruction|habitat loss]].

==Description and distribution==
The species is {{convert|4|m}} tall and is native to [[Taiwan]]. However, it has been introduced to [[United States|US]] states such as [[Alabama]], [[Arkansas]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[Florida]] and [[South Carolina]].<ref name=hsu/>
